posts.zh:
dsh-prompt-optimizer 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。输入框下方「优化提示词」按钮：一键把草稿重写为更清晰、更可执行的提示词，弹出前后对比，支持一键替换回输入框。

posts.en:
dsh-prompt-optimizer is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Optimize Prompt button under the composer: one click rewrites your draft into a clearer, more executable prompt, with a before-and-after dialog and one-click replacement.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-dae21e9f3f50a21b294b.html
